data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Karthik Gollapudi and Austin Spiegel that has raised $67M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Scale AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, Field AI) alongside 1 public comparable (Palantir), supplemented by 8 additional private reference points.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis, using total raised ($67M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yields $127M. The Peer-Median method across the 4 core comparables produces a median valuation of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI). The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in company maturity and market positioning within the AI & Software frontier space.

Triangulated across both methods, the analysis supports a valuation range of $108M (low) to $5.1B (high), with a median point of $2.3B. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median signals material uncertainty around whether Sift Stack's business trajectory and capital efficiency align with high-growth frontier AI comparables or should be discounted toward earlier-stage fundamentals. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to the peer cohort.
